 Nagri.

Mr. Ankit Chauhan, Ad
 along with Respondent
 Vc)
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Amit Sharma
 Order

The medical report with respect to the daughter of the applicant has been verified by the Investigating Officer, and the status report dated 17.03.2023, authored by Inspector Randhir Singh,
SHO/Nand Nagri has been placed on record in that regard.
In the said status report, it has been stated the documents of the daughter of the applicant were genuine and she is stated to have Erbs Palsy Right Side.
It is further stated that the patient is required to be reviewed in OPD for further opinion and assessment of the nature of ailment.

2. In view of the aforesaid facts, the present applicant is directed to be released on interim bail till the next date of hearing, on his furnishing a personal bond of Rs. 25,000/- with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court/Link Court in case FIR No. 198/2021 under Sections 498A/304B of the IPC, registered at P.S. Nand Nagri, further subject to following conditions:
i.
The applicant shall not leave the country without prior permission of the trial Court.
ii. The applicant shall intimate the trial Court by way of an affidavit and to the Investigating Officer regarding any change in residential address.
iii. The applicant shall appear before the Court as and when the matter is taken up for hearing iv.
The applicant shall join investigation as and when called by the Investigating Officer concerned.
